1: import { countPipelineData, emptyPipelineData, parseBlockParams } from "@reqflow/core";
2: import { defineBlock } from "@reqflow/engine";
3: 
4: /** Mirrors BLOCK_SPECS.hil.params (validated by parseBlockParams before use). */
5: interface HilParams {
6:   reviewer: "pm" | "expert" | "anyone";
7:   instructions: string;
8:   approvals: number;
9:   allowEdits: boolean;
10: }
11: 
12: const REVIEWER: Record<HilParams["reviewer"], string> = {
13:   pm: "the product manager",
14:   expert: "a domain expert",
15:   anyone: "a team member",
16: };
17: 
18: /** "3 sources, 12 records" — only the parts that are there. */
19: export function describeData(counts: ReturnType<typeof countPipelineData>): string {
20:   const parts = Object.entries(counts)
21:     .filter(([, n]) => n > 0)
22:     .map(([key, n]) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? key.replace(/s$/, "") : key}`);
23:   return parts.join(", ");
24: }
25: 
26: /**
27:  * Human in the loop. On the first run it pauses the flow until a person has reviewed what arrived
28:  * (the engine marks the run `waiting_for_review`). When the run is resumed, it passes the data on.
29:  * Reviewer edits are made through the requirement API and audited there, not inside this block;
30:  * the resume handler checks that the required number of approvals was given.
31:  */
32: export const hilBlock = defineBlock({
33:   kind: "hil",
34:   async run(inputs, rawParams, ctx) {
35:     const params = parseBlockParams("hil", rawParams) as unknown as HilParams;
36:     const input = inputs.in ?? emptyPipelineData();
37:     const what = describeData(countPipelineData(input));
38: 
39:     if (!what) {
40:       ctx.log("Nothing arrived to review, so the flow continues with an empty stream.");
41:       return { status: "ok", outputs: { out: input } };
42:     }
43:     if (!ctx.resumed) {
44:       const approvals = params.approvals > 1 ? ` (${params.approvals} approvals needed)` : "";
45:       const message = `Waiting for ${REVIEWER[params.reviewer]} to review ${what}${approvals}.`;
46:       ctx.log(message);
47:       return { status: "paused", message };
48:     }
49:     ctx.log(`Review finished. Passing on ${what}.`);
50:     return { status: "ok", outputs: { out: input } };
51:   },
52: });
</content>

10: /** Recognize explicit original identities, not arbitrary row values or matching opinion text. */
11: function field(record: SourceRecord, names: string[]): string | undefined {
12:   const normalized = new Set(names.map((n) => n.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")));
13:   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(record.fields ?? {})) {
14:     if (
15:       normalized.has(key.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")) &&
16:       ((typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) || typeof value === "number")
17:     )
18:       return String(value);
19:   }
20:   return undefined;
21: }
22: function hash(value: unknown): string {
23:   return createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(value)).digest("hex");
24: }
25: 
26: /**
27:  * Units are feedback entries, never persons. Explicit provider/original IDs identify syndication.
28:  * Without those IDs, URI + locator + full content hash only deduplicates cross-source reimports
29:  * with one entry per source. Identical text from different IDs/customers remains independent.
30:  * No global text deduplication; content hashes never identify a unit on their own.
31:  */
32: export function feedbackUnits(
33:   records: SourceRecord[],
34:   sources: Map<string, Source>,
35: ): Map<string, string> {
36:   const ids = new Map<string, string>();
37:   const possibleReimports = new Map<string, SourceRecord[]>();
38:   for (const record of records) {
39:     const source = sources.get(record.sourceId)!;
40:     const original = field(record, [
41:       "originalId",
42:       "originalRecordId",
43:       "providerRecordId",
44:       "reviewId",
45:       "feedbackId",
46:       "responseId",
47:       "commentId",
48:     ]);
49:     const customer = field(record, ["customerId", "respondentId", "authorId", "userId"]);
50:     const provider = field(record, ["provider", "providerId", "providerName"]);
51:     const originUri =
52:       field(record, [
53:         "canonicalUri",
54:         "canonicalUrl",
55:         "originalUrl",
56:         "syndicatedFrom",
57:         "sourceUri",
58:       ]) ?? source.uri;
59:     if (original !== undefined) {
60:       ids.set(
61:         record.id,
62:         `unit_${hash(["original", provider ?? originUri ?? source.id, original, customer ?? null])}`,
63:       );
64:     } else {
65:       ids.set(record.id, `unit_${hash(["record", record.sourceId, record.id])}`);
66:       if (originUri && record.locator) {
67:         const key = hash([
68:           "reimport",
69:           originUri,
70:           record.locator,
71:           customer ?? null,
72:           hash(record.text),
73:         ]);
74:         const group = possibleReimports.get(key) ?? [];
75:         group.push(record);
76:         possibleReimports.set(key, group);
77:       }
78:     }
79:   }
80:   for (const [key, records] of possibleReimports) {
81:     const distinctSources = new Set(records.map((r) => r.sourceId));
82:     if (distinctSources.size > 1 && distinctSources.size === records.length) {
83:       for (const record of records) ids.set(record.id, `unit_${key}`);
84:     }
85:   }
86:   return ids;
87: }

130:   const aborted = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
131:     listener = () => reject(ctx.signal.reason);
132:     ctx.signal.addEventListener("abort", listener, { once: true });
133:   });
134:   try {
135:     const result = await Promise.race([
136:       ctx.llm.generateObject({ ...request, signal: ctx.signal }),
137:       aborted,
138:     ]);
139:     ctx.signal.throwIfAborted();
140:     return {
141:       object: request.schema.parse(result.object),
142:       model: z.string().min(1).parse(result.model),
143:     };
144:   } finally {

content.text:
Two confirmed findings:

- **P2 — `packages/blocks/src/ai-splitter/feedback-units.ts:40–48`:** Missing `originalCommentId` alias, although JSON ingestion recognizes it. Syndicated copies count independently. Synthetic reproduction inflated support **1→2**, demand score **65→100**, and routing **out-1→out-0**. **Fix:** recognize `originalCommentId`, including normalized forms such as `Original Comment ID`.

- **P2 — `packages/blocks/src/ai-splitter/raw-analysis.ts:134–137,240–243`:** `validateIds` echoes unknown model-supplied IDs into errors (`protocol.ts:96`); executor persists them in run errors and the failure audit (`executor.ts:487–502`). A synthetic peer returning source text as an ID reproduced the leak. **Fix:** use sanitized index/count-only validation errors without interpolating untrusted model values.

**Verification:** 252 scoped tests passed; scoped TypeScript checks passed for core, blocks, engine, db, and llm. No files edited or agents launched.
